metadata.notes: Comprehensive test suite covering multi-method payment orchestration, eligibility rules, state transitions, API endpoints, error handling, gateway failover, and reconciliation.

test_cases.scenario: Fetch server-driven method list for standard order -> All eight payment methods displayed
test_cases.description: Verifies that the payment page successfully retrieves and renders all eight payment methods from the server-driven method list for a standard eligible order.
preconditions: Checkout service has created a valid payment intent for a standard order of ₹2,500
steps: Send GET /v1/payments/intents/{id} or load payment page
Inspect the list of allowed methods returned in the response
test_cases.expected_result: Response contains all 8 payment methods (Cards, UPI, Net Banking, Wallets & Postpaid, E-Gift Vouchers, Pay Later, EMI, Cash on Delivery) with eligibility status true.

test_cases.scenario: Fetch method list with invalid intent ID or unauthenticated request -> Returns 404 or 401 error
test_cases.description: Verifies validation and negative handling when requesting payment methods with an invalid intent identifier.
test_cases.expected_result: API returns 404 Not Found error with proper error schema and no method list.

test_cases.scenario: Submit payment attempt with duplicate Idempotency-Key within 24 hours -> Original attempt returned without double charge
test_cases.description: Verifies idempotency enforcement ensuring duplicate requests with the same Idempotency-Key return the original transaction without initiating a second charge.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/intents/{id}/attempts with header Idempotency-Key: IDEMP-KEY-998877
Resend the identical POST request with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours
test_cases.expected_result: First request initiates payment attempt (201 Created); second request returns the exact same attempt record without creating a new payment attempt or charging the buyer again.

test_cases.scenario: Submit payment attempt with missing Idempotency-Key header -> Returns validation error
test_cases.description: Verifies validation requirement ensuring that idempotency key header is strictly required for attempt creation.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/intents/{id}/attempts without Idempotency-Key header
test_cases.expected_result: API returns 400 Bad Request or 422 Unprocessable Entity stating Idempotency-Key header is required.

test_cases.scenario: Gateway success rate drops below threshold -> Traffic automatically shifts to secondary gateway
test_cases.description: Verifies automatic failover routing when the primary gateway experiences a degradation in success rate.
preconditions: Primary gateway (Gateway A) success rate drops 10 points below 24-hour average
steps: Simulate continuous failures on Gateway A over a 10-minute window
Initiate a new Card payment attempt
test_cases.expected_result: Orchestrator automatically routes the payment attempt to Gateway B without requiring a deployment or client release.

test_cases.scenario: Both primary and secondary gateways are completely unavailable -> Returns PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE error
test_cases.description: Verifies error handling when failover cannot route traffic because both primary and secondary gateways are down.
preconditions: Gateway A and Gateway B both experiencing outages
steps: Initiate payment attempt when both primary and secondary gateways are unavailable
test_cases.expected_result: API returns error with code PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE and buyer message 'This option is slow right now. Try another.'

test_cases.scenario: View payment methods for Buyer Protection or Luxury cart -> Cash on Delivery is hidden
test_cases.description: Verifies that Cash on Delivery is hidden for Buyer Protection and Luxury orders per listing-type eligibility rules.
preconditions: Buyer has a Luxury listing in the cart
steps: Create payment intent for the Luxury cart
Fetch allowed payment methods via GET /v1/payments/intents/{id}
test_cases.expected_result: Allowed methods list contains prepaid options but excludes Cash on Delivery, with eligibility reason stating COD isn't available for Luxury items.

test_cases.scenario: View payment methods for Bulk order cart -> Prepaid methods allowed and Cash on Delivery hidden
test_cases.description: Verifies that Bulk orders permit all prepaid methods while hiding Cash on Delivery.
preconditions: Buyer has a Bulk order in the cart
steps: Create payment intent for Bulk order
Inspect allowed methods
test_cases.expected_result: All prepaid methods are allowed; Cash on Delivery is hidden.

test_cases.scenario: View payment methods for mixed cart containing Luxury and Standard items -> Strictest rule wins and COD is hidden
test_cases.description: Verifies that when a cart mixes item types, the strictest rule applies (hiding COD for Luxury/Buyer Protection/Bulk).
preconditions: Cart contains both Standard and Luxury items
steps: Create payment intent for mixed cart
Fetch allowed payment methods
test_cases.expected_result: Cash on Delivery is hidden due to the Luxury item constraint winning.

test_cases.scenario: Check EMI eligibility for order amount below minimum threshold -> EMI method unavailable
test_cases.description: Verifies boundary condition for EMI eligibility where order amounts under ₹3,000 do not qualify for EMI.
steps: Request EMI plans or check allowed methods for amount 299900 (₹2,999)
Test boundary amount 300000 (₹3,000)
test_cases.expected_result: For ₹2,999, EMI is ineligible and hidden; for ₹3,000, EMI is eligible and available.

test_cases.scenario: Check Cash on Delivery eligibility across order amount boundary -> COD blocked above ₹50,000
test_cases.description: Verifies boundary condition for Cash on Delivery amount cap at ₹50,000 (testing ₹50,000 vs ₹50,001).
preconditions: Order has serviceable PIN code and normal items
steps: Create payment intent with amount 5000000 (₹50,000) and check COD eligibility
Create payment intent with amount 5000100 (₹50,001) and check COD eligibility
test_cases.expected_result: COD is available for ₹50,000; COD is hidden for ₹50,001 with eligibility reason.

test_cases.scenario: Attempt Cash on Delivery with buyer having 2+ refused orders in 90 days -> COD blocked
test_cases.description: Verifies that buyers with 2 or more refused COD orders in the last 90 days cannot select Cash on Delivery.
preconditions: Buyer account has 2 refused COD deliveries within past 90 days
steps: Create payment intent for eligible standard order
Fetch allowed payment methods
test_cases.expected_result: Cash on Delivery is marked ineligible and hidden for the buyer.

test_cases.scenario: Payment intent expires after 30 minutes of inactivity -> Status updates to EXPIRED and payment blocked
test_cases.description: Verifies that unpaid payment intents automatically expire after 30 minutes.
preconditions: Payment intent created with status OPEN
steps: Simulate passage of 31 minutes without successful payment
Attempt to initiate a payment attempt on the expired intent
test_cases.expected_result: Intent status transitions to EXPIRED, attempt creation returns 422 with intent expired error, and buyer sees 'Session expired. Please restart checkout.'

test_cases.scenario: Receive late payment success webhook after intent has expired -> System triggers automatic refund
test_cases.description: Verifies that if payment success arrives after the intent has expired, the payment is automatically refunded so the buyer is never charged for an unplaced order.
steps: Send webhook callback with SUCCEEDED status for an expired intent
test_cases.expected_result: System records attempt success but immediately initiates an auto-refund for the transaction and notifies the buyer.

test_cases.scenario: Initiate Card payment with saved token -> Redirects to 3-D Secure authentication page
test_cases.description: Verifies that selecting a saved network-tokenised card initiates a payment attempt redirecting to 3-D Secure.
preconditions: Buyer has a saved network-tokenised card
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/intents/{id}/attempts with method CARD and saved token
Inspect response next action
test_cases.expected_result: Response returns NextAction with redirect URL to 3-D Secure page, keeping card data out of server scope.

test_cases.scenario: Initiate UPI payment attempt -> Client polls status every 3s and handles webhook source of truth
test_cases.description: Verifies UPI intent initiation, client polling mechanism every 3 seconds for up to 5 minutes, and webhook callback handling.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/intents/{id}/attempts for UPI intent
Client polls GET /v1/payments/attempts/{id} every 3 seconds
Simulate webhook callback confirming payment success
test_cases.expected_result: Attempt returns intent URI, client successfully polls status while showing approval timer, and webhook terminal state updates intent to PAID.

test_cases.scenario: Perform split tender with E-Gift Voucher and UPI -> Voucher amount blocked and remainder paid via UPI
test_cases.description: Verifies split tender payment using an E-Gift Voucher (up to 3 vouchers) combined with one other payment method.
steps: Apply gift voucher ₹1,000 (Attempt 1 succeeds, blocking voucher funds)
Pay remaining ₹1,500 via UPI (Attempt 2 succeeds)
test_cases.expected_result: Intent status becomes PAID with amount_captured_minor equaling total order amount.

test_cases.scenario: Split tender second attempt fails -> Held gift voucher funds released after intent expires
test_cases.description: Verifies that when a split tender second attempt fails, the gift voucher funds held during the attempt are released when the intent expires.
steps: Simulate failure of second payment attempt for remainder
Allow payment intent to reach 30-minute expiration
test_cases.expected_result: Held gift voucher funds are released back to the voucher balance upon intent expiration.

test_cases.scenario: Attempt payment with insufficient funds -> Returns normalised INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS error code and message
test_cases.description: Verifies error handling and normalisation when an issuer or wallet declines a payment due to low balance.
steps: Initiate payment attempt that results in insufficient funds response from provider
Inspect API response and error code
test_cases.expected_result: API returns error with code INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS and buyer-facing message 'Not enough balance. Pay the rest with another method.'

test_cases.scenario: Attempt payment with declined card -> Returns PAYMENT_DECLINED error code and message
test_cases.description: Verifies normalisation of card decline responses from gateway into standard PAYMENT_DECLINED error.
steps: Initiate card payment with test card triggering issuer decline
test_cases.expected_result: Response indicates failure with code PAYMENT_DECLINED and message 'Your bank declined this payment. Try another method.'

test_cases.scenario: Receive webhook callback with valid HMAC signature and duplicate event -> First terminal status wins
test_cases.description: Verifies webhook security via HMAC signature verification and idempotency processing where duplicate webhooks do not alter final state.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/webhooks/{provider} with valid signature and SUCCEEDED status
Resend identical webhook payload
test_cases.expected_result: First webhook updates attempt to SUCCEEDED; duplicate webhook is logged only without changing state or triggering duplicate processing.

test_cases.scenario: Receive webhook callback with invalid HMAC signature -> Rejected with 401 Unauthorized
test_cases.description: Verifies security control rejecting tampered or unverified webhook requests.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments/webhooks/{provider} with invalid signature header
test_cases.expected_result: Endpoint rejects request with 401 Unauthorized and does not process payload.

coverage_summary.notes: The test suite thoroughly covers multi-method payment orchestration, eligibility rules for restricted items (Luxury, Bulk, Buyer Protection), state machine transitions, split tenders, idempotency, gateway failover, and reconciliation, preserving exact requirement and AC IDs from inputs.

requirements.text: The system shall support eight payment methods (Cards, UPI, Net Banking, Wallets & Postpaid, E-Gift Vouchers, Pay Later, EMI, and Cash on Delivery) on web, Android, and iOS from one server-driven method list.
Every payment attempt shall be idempotent and reconciled daily against gateway settlement files without losing or double-charging a payment.
The system shall route traffic around a failing gateway to a secondary gateway without requiring a release.
The system shall enforce payment method eligibility rules based on cart type, order amount, PIN code, and buyer history.
The system shall maintain a payment intent lifecycle and a payment attempt state machine with terminal states Succeeded, Failed, COD confirmed, and Auto-refunded.
The system shall provide method-specific initiation, callback handling, and status checking via isolated adapters.

The payment API shall provide endpoints for intent creation, intent retrieval, attempt initiation, attempt status checking, webhooks, and EMI plans with signature verification and idempotency enforcement.

The system shall enforce security and compliance controls including PCI DSS scoping via gateway-hosted fields, network-tokenised saved cards, data localisation in India, and HMAC signature verification for webhooks.

acceptance_criteria.text: Payment page displays server-driven method list containing all applicable methods for the order.
Submitting an attempt with a duplicate Idempotency-Key within 24 hours returns the original attempt rather than creating a new charge.
Traffic automatically shifts from primary gateway to secondary gateway when success rate drops 10 points below the 24-hour average.
Buyer Protection and Luxury orders hide Cash on Delivery.
Bulk orders allow all prepaid methods and hide Cash on Delivery.
If a cart mixes types, the strictest rule wins (hiding COD for Luxury/Buyer Protection/Bulk).
EMI requires order amount >= ₹3,000 and an eligible card and tenure.
Cash on Delivery is hidden for orders > ₹50,000, unserviceable PIN codes, or buyers with 2+ refused COD orders in 90 days.
Payment intent transitions through OPEN, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, COD_CONFIRMED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED states correctly.
A late success received after intent expiration triggers an automatic refund.
Cards adapter redirects to 3-D Secure page and supports tokenised saved cards.
UPI adapter returns intent URI or QR code, polls every 3s for up to 5 min, and treats webhook as source of truth.
Gift vouchers allow split tender with one other method and up to 3 vouchers per order.
API endpoints return correct normalise error codes and messages (PAYMENT_DECLINED, AUTH_FAILED, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, METHOD_NOT_ELIGIBLE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, PAYMENT_TIMEOUT, INTENT_EXPIRED).
Webhooks verify HMAC signatures, check IP allow-lists, and enforce a replay window of 5 minutes.

business_rules.text: COD is blocked for Buyer Protection, Luxury, Bulk items, orders over ₹50,000, unserviceable PIN codes, and buyers with 2+ refused COD orders in the last 90 days.
EMI requires order amount of at least ₹3,000 and an eligible card/tenure combination.
Payment intent expires exactly 30 minutes after creation if unpaid.
Split tender with Gift Voucher holds the voucher amount for 30 minutes; if the second attempt fails and intent expires, held voucher funds are released.
Webhook and redirect may arrive in any order; the first terminal status wins and later ones are logged only.
